title: blacklist /stats query excludes active peers with future blacklist expiry
description: transit/admin.rs: stats query WHERE blacklisted_until IS NULL OR blacklisted_until = 0 excludes peers with a past blacklist (correct) but also excludes peers with a future blacklist timestamp, treating them as not-present in active counts. Query should be: WHERE (blacklisted_until IS NULL OR blacklisted_until < current_timestamp_ms).
